description: AutoPilot runs the AI Text Generator with Claude, but the user has no Anthropic key, so the block answers with its sign-in card and AutoPilot stops. The user starts adding a key, cancels, and asks AutoPilot to skip it instead; AutoPilot answers that message once and nothing else runs. copilot-connect-card-journey.spec.ts follows it.
title: A line about the sea

turns.text: I'll write that line with the AI Text Generator, using Claude.

input.prompt: Write one line about the sea.

turns.text: It needs your Anthropic API key first. Connect one on the card and I'll carry on.
No problem, I've left it. Ask me again whenever you want it.
